title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1158: The city of Munich is founded by Henry the Lion on the banks of the river Isar.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1216: First Barons' War: Prince Louis of France takes the city of Winchester, abandoned by John, King of England, and soon conquers over half of the kingdom.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1276: While in exile in Fuzhou, away from the advancing Mongol invaders, the remnants of the Song dynasty court hold the coronation ceremony for Emperor Duanzong.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1285: Second Mongol invasion of Vietnam: Forces led by Prince Trần Quang Khải of the Trần dynasty destroy most of the invading Mongol naval fleet in a battle at Chuong Duong.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1287: Kublai Khan defeats the force of Nayan and other traditionalist Borjigin princes in East Mongolia and Manchuria.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1381: Richard II of England meets leaders of the Peasants' Revolt at Mile End. The Tower of London is stormed by rebels who enter without resistance.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1404: Welsh rebel leader Owain Glyndŵr, having declared himself Prince of Wales, allies himself with the French against King Henry IV of England.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1618: Joris Veseler prints the first Dutch newspaper Courante uyt Italien, Duytslandt, &c. in Amsterdam (approximate date).

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1645: English Civil War: Battle of Naseby: Twelve thousand Royalist forces are beaten by fifteen thousand Parliamentarian soldiers.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1658: Franco-Spanish War: Turenne and the French army win a decisive victory over the Spanish at the battle of the Dunes.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1666: A four day long naval engagement between the Dutch and English fleet ends, with the English suffering heavier losses.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1690: King William III of England (William of Orange) lands in Ireland to confront the former King James II.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1775: American Revolutionary War: the Continental Army is established by the Continental Congress, marking the birth of the United States Armed Forces.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1777: The Second Continental Congress passes the Flag Act of 1777 adopting the Stars and Stripes as the Flag of the United States.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1789: Mutiny on the Bounty: HMS Bounty mutiny survivors including Captain William Bligh and 18 others reach Timor after a nearly 7,400 km (4,600 mi) journey in an open boat.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1800: The French Army of First Consul Napoleon Bonaparte defeats the Austrians at the Battle of Marengo in Northern Italy and re-conquers Italy.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1807: Emperor Napoleon's French Grande Armée defeats the Russian Army at the Battle of Friedland in Poland (modern Russian  Kaliningrad Oblast) ending the War of the Fourth Coalition.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1821: Badi VII, king of Sennar, surrenders his throne and realm to Ismail Pasha, general of the Ottoman Empire, bringing the 300 year old Sudanese kingdom to an end.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1822: Charles Babbage proposes a difference engine in a paper to the Royal Astronomical Society.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1830: Beginning of the French colonization of Algeria: Thirty-four thousand French soldiers begin their invasion of Algiers, landing 27 kilometers west at Sidi Fredj.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1839: Henley Royal Regatta: the village of Henley-on-Thames, on the River Thames in Oxfordshire, stages its first regatta.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1846: Bear Flag Revolt begins: Anglo settlers in Sonoma, California, start a rebellion against Mexico and proclaim the California Republic.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1863: American Civil War: Second Battle of Winchester: A Union garrison is defeated by the Army of Northern Virginia in the Shenandoah Valley town of Winchester, Virginia.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1863: Second Assault on the Confederate works at the Siege of Port Hudson during the American Civil War.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1872: Trade unions are legalized in Canada.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1888: The White Rajahs territories become the British protectorate of Sarawak.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1900: Hawaii becomes a United States territory.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1900: The second German Naval Law calls for the Imperial German Navy to be doubled in size, resulting in an Anglo-German naval arms race.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1907: The National Association for Women's Suffrage succeeds in getting Norwegian women the right to vote in parliamentary elections.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1919: John Alcock and Arthur Whitten Brown depart from St. John's, Newfoundland on the first nonstop transatlantic flight.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1926: Brazil leaves the League of Nations.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1931: A deadly tornado strikes Birmingham, England, damaging 2,221 homes and businesses.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1934: The landmark Australian Eastern Mission returns from its three-month tour of East and South-East Asia.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1937: Pennsylvania becomes the first (and only) state of the United States to celebrate Flag Day officially as a state holiday.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1937: U.S. House of Representatives passes the Marihuana Tax Act.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1940: World War II: The German occupation of Paris begins.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1940: The Soviet Union presents an ultimatum to Lithuania, resulting in Lithuanian loss of independence.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1940: Seven hundred and twenty-eight Polish political prisoners from Tarnów become the first inmates of the Auschwitz concentration camp.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1949: Albert II, a rhesus monkey, rides a V-2 rocket to an altitude of 134 km (83 mi), thereby becoming the first mammal and first monkey in space.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1950: An Air France Douglas DC-4 crashes near Bahrain International Airport, killing 40 people. This came two days after another Air France DC-4 crashed in the same location.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1951: UNIVAC I is dedicated by the U.S. Census Bureau.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1954: U.S. President Dwight D. Eisenhower signs a bill into law that places the words "under God" into the United States Pledge of Allegiance.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1955: Chile becomes a signatory to the Buenos Aires copyright treaty.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1959: Disneyland Monorail System, the first daily operating monorail system in the Western Hemisphere, opens to the public in Anaheim, California.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1962: The European Space Research Organisation is established in Paris – later becoming the European Space Agency.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1966: The Vatican announces the abolition of the Index Librorum Prohibitorum ("index of prohibited books"), which was originally instituted in 1557.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)
text: June 14, 1967: Mariner program: Mariner 5 is launched towards Venus.

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)

title: June 14 (Wikipedia)

title: June 15 (Wikipedia)

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)
text: June 16, 1811: Survivors of an attack the previous day by Tla-o-qui-aht on board the Pacific Fur Company's ship Tonquin, intentionally detonate a powder magazine on the ship, destroying it and killing about 100 attackers.

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)
text: June 16, 1815: Battle of Ligny and Battle of Quatre Bras, two days before the Battle of Waterloo.

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)
text: June 16, 1819: A major earthquake strikes the Kutch district of western India, killing over 1,543 people and raising a 6-metre-high (20 ft), 6-kilometre-wide (3.7 mi), ridge, extending for at least 80 kilometres (50 mi), that was known as the Allah Bund ("Dam of God").

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)
text: June 16, 1824: A meeting at Old Slaughter's coffee house in London leads to the formation of what is now the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA).

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)
text: June 16, 1836: The formation of the London Working Men's Association gives rise to the Chartist Movement.

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)

title: June 16 (Wikipedia)

text: June 17, 1939: Last public guillotining in France: Eugen Weidmann, a convicted murderer, is executed in Versailles outside the Saint-Pierre prison.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1940: World War II: RMS Lancastria is attacked and sunk by the Luftwaffe near Saint-Nazaire, France. At least 3,000 are killed in Britain's worst maritime disaster.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1940: World War II: The British Army's 11th Hussars assault and take Fort Capuzzo in Libya from Italian forces.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1940: The three Baltic states of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania fall under the occupation of the Soviet Union.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1944: Iceland declares independence from Denmark and becomes a republic.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1948: United Airlines Flight 624, a Douglas DC-6, crashes near Mount Carmel, Pennsylvania, killing all 43 people on board.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1952: Guatemala passes Decree 900, ordering the redistribution of uncultivated land.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1953: Cold War: East Germany Workers Uprising: In East Germany, the Soviet Union orders a division of troops into East Berlin to quell a rebellion.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1960: The Nez Perce tribe is awarded $4 million for 7 million acres (28,000 km2) of land undervalued at four cents/acre in the 1863 treaty.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1963: The United States Supreme Court rules 8–1 in Abington School District v. Schempp against requiring the reciting of Bible verses and the Lord's Prayer in public schools.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1963: A day after South Vietnamese president Ngô Đình Diệm announced the Joint Communiqué to end the Buddhist crisis, a riot involving around 2,000 people breaks out. One person is killed.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1967: Nuclear weapons testing: China announces a successful test of its first thermonuclear weapon.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1971: U.S. president Richard Nixon in a televised press conference called drug abuse "America's public enemy number one", starting the war on drugs.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1972: Watergate scandal: Five White House operatives are arrested for burgling the offices of the Democratic National Committee during an attempt by members of the administration of President Richard M. Nixon to illegally wiretap the political opposition as part of a broader campaign to subvert the democratic process.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1985: Space Shuttle program: STS-51-G mission: Space Shuttle Discovery launches carrying Sultan bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, the first Arab and first Muslim in space, as a payload specialist.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1987: With the death of the last individual of the species, the dusky seaside sparrow becomes extinct.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1989: Interflug Flight 102 crashes during a rejected takeoff from Berlin Schönefeld Airport, killing 21 people.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1991: Apartheid: The South African Parliament repeals the Population Registration Act which required racial classification of all South Africans at birth.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1992: A "joint understanding" agreement on arms reduction is signed by U.S. president George Bush and Russian president Boris Yeltsin (this would be later codified in START II).

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)
text: June 17, 1994: Following a televised low-speed highway chase, O. J. Simpson is arrested for the murders of his ex-wife, Nicole Brown Simpson, and her friend Ronald Goldman.

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)

title: June 17 (Wikipedia)

title: June 18 (Wikipedia)
text: June 18, 1429: Charles VII's army defeats an English army under John Talbot at the Battle of Patay during the Hundred Years' War. The English lost 2,200 men, over half their army, crippling their efforts during this segment of the war.
